title: Mixed Event — The Sounds of a Summer Festival! — Episode1 Memories of Failure

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!
meta.Event Outline: Akito and Toya are invited to perform at the Summer Festival's live concert as a substitute act. Back when Akito had lost sight of his goals after facing setbacks in soccer, he and Ena witnessed that very same event...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Shota, you looked like you were out of gas in the second half. You gotta work on your conditioning more.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I'll make sure to run more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: But your goal at the end was so cool, Akito. You really are our team's ace!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Well, duh.
An ace can't be an ace if they don't score, right?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Haha. And we don't expect anything less from you.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: But since we've made it this far, we're gonna win it all. That means we're definitely winning our next one too.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, but our next opponent is really good too... You sure we can beat them?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: What are you saying that for? We've just gotta win no matter who we end up playing against!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
S-Sorry!
I'll make sure to run more from now on.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Well, whenever you're in trouble, just know that you can pass the ball off to me...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (Akito's kinda scary on the outside, but he's really a nice guy that everybody can count on...)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Thanks, Akito...!
Let's win the next tournament too!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: That's right, I'll be there to take down whoever comes at us!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (Alright, the tournament's tomorrow. No mistakes from here on out...!)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I could be asking you the same thing. You stayed behind to practice more?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Yup. We're playing against a pretty good team tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: And it's our last match as sixth graders. We can't leave anything behind on our way out.

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Just like a true ace...!
You're the coolest, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Quit exaggerating, will you?
I just don't want to miss out, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hey, can I stay and practice with you?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: I wanna do everything I can too!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Alright, but no running out of gas like that other time.
The day of the tournament - Quarterfinals

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Alright, win this one and we're through to the finals!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: The other team's full of kids that were pulled from famous junior clubs, but we made it this far, so we're gonna win this thing...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Of course we are. There's no way we're gonna lose!

rows.Speaker: Opponent Player A
rows.Line: Nice, we're racking up goals left and right. We've got this!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Dammit, they're up three goals already!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (They just keep catching our defenders off guard by slipping behind them...!)

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: They're playing like they're the favorites...

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: They're too good. There's no way we can beat them...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, don't give up yet!
We decided that we're gonna win it all, right?!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Get the ball to me the next time you can. I'll get a goal for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Just don't give up until it's over, alright? Just run! Keep running! Don't let go!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
Yeah, we're not losing this...!
It all starts with one goal...!

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
(They're defending way too well.
I can't get it by them...)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
(Oh, Akito, wow...!
He peeled that guy off like it was nothing!)

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: (Now's my chance to get the ball to him...)

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: Whoa, they got through all those defenders...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: We're gonna win this match and the whole tournament! We've gotta keep scoring!

rows.Speaker: Opponent Players
rows.Line: That kid's good. I lost him for a second there.

rows.Speaker: Opponent Players
rows.Line:
But no more...
Let's regroup and get back out there!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hey, they scored again!
And they're back up three?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: The Shibuya Diamonds just can't keep up, and they've got less than five minutes... Can they pull this off...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line:
They're totally in control now...
We can't even get a hold of the ball anymore.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
No, we still have time!!
Don't give up until it's over!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (We said we'd win...! I said we'd win...! Things can't end like this!)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
We couldn't we win?!
We worked so hard to get here...!

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: We just never stood a chance...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: You guys...! Don't say stuff like that! That's when it really becomes impossible to win!

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: No, we really didn't stand a chance! Musashino East is full of kids that left home and came all the way here to just play soccer, right?

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: I heard that they practice forever after school too. It's like they're never not kicking around a ball.

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: I mean, they're all serious about going pro, right? They're sacrificing all their free time just to achieve that goal.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (But I always took soccer seriously and did everything I could...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (I never even thought about leaving home to practice playing soccer from dawn to dusk.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: (But still, I was being serious... I...)

rows.Speaker: Teammates
rows.Line: There's no way we could beat anyone who's that focused on their goals...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: That was a rough match. It would've been nice to finish the sixth grade with a win... But we still managed to score a goal against them, so that counts, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, you're gonna keep playing in junior high, right? Let's join the same team!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: Playing against those guys made me realize something today...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: They made me doubt how serious I was about playing soccer.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: I asked myself if I could do more than they're doing right now, if I could do more in the future...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: And I couldn't think of an answer...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
I'm such a loser...
I talked so big and acted like some kind of bigshot...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: But now I don't know what to do. That just means I wasn't really that serious to begin with...

rows.Speaker: Shota
rows.Line: But I thought you were the most serious about playing soccer out of all of us! Sure the other team was really good, but you're our ace...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line: I'll never be happy with just that...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for being such a useless Ace.
Bye...
Who would've thought that we'd run into each other here...!
Akito and his team might just turn this event on its head...
